title: Paano Tinatantiya ang Solar System Size?
premise: Preliminary size = daily kWh divided by local sun hours; it is only an estimate until roof, shade and load timing are checked.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the episode plan (data/episodes.json) title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-25.

sources: Sources: UMD & Illinois Extension solar sizing guides; NREL PVWatts;

cues.text: Paano malalaman kung ilang kW ang solar na kailangan mo?
cues.say: Paano malalaman kung ilang kilowatt ang solar na kailangan mo?

cues.text: Nagsisimula 'yan sa kWh na nagamit mo kada buwan.
cues.say: Nagsisimula 'yan sa kilowatt-hour na nagamit mo kada buwan.

cues.text: Gawin itong kada araw, tapos hatiin sa sun hours ng lugar mo.
Pero tantiya lang 'yan, kasi galing lang sa bill.
Titingnan pa ang bubong, ang anino, at kung kailan ka gumagamit.
Kaya mahalaga ang site visit bago ang final na quote.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: Preliminary sizing starts from monthly kWh use.

sources.title: Solar and Net Metering
excerpts: Your system supplies the property first while it is generating.
The Meralco grid supplies the property when renewable generation is not enough.
an exported kilowatt-hour is not exchanged one-for-one at the full retail rate.
The Net Metering peso credit is applied to eligible bill charges under the current rules,
based on the applicable monthly blended generation cost rather than the full retail rate. (FAQ 11)

sources.title: PVWatts Calculator (system losses: soiling, shading, orientation)
excerpts: Output depends on location, tilt, azimuth (direction), shading and other system losses.

sources.title: Estimate system size and cost
excerpts: Average your monthly kWh from past bills, then divide by local sun hours to estimate system size.

sources.title: Working on Solar: Design and System Sizing (FS-2023-0655)
excerpts: Preliminary size: energy use divided by peak sun hours; use 12-24 months of kWh history; treat as a first estimate before site-specific design.
